diag.localConfig.unreadable: The domain configuration snippet cannot be read safely.

diag.log.ok: No recognized error markers were found in the last 64 KiB of the domain error log.

diag.log.unreadable: The domain error log could not be read safely.

diag.tasks.ok: Task definitions for this domain pass the task editor’s validation. This does not verify that commands will succeed.

diag.tlsFile.unresolved: The path contains unresolved variables. It was not checked.

diag.settings.ok: Explicit port, IP, switch, engine and alias values pass the format checks.

projectDb.title: Database
projectDb.name: New database name
projectDb.invalidName: Use 1–63 Latin letters, digits or underscores. Start with a letter or underscore.
projectDb.sqliteHint: The file {path} will be created and migrated when Laravel is installed. No database server is required.

wordpress.pending: The public directory and placeholder are ready. WordPress has not been installed yet.
wordpress.hint: Download the official WordPress archive, verify its checksum and extract into public/. OSPanel settings in .osp are preserved. After restarting OSPanel, open the site to finish the WordPress setup wizard.

wordpress.done: WordPress files installed. Restart OSPanel and open the site to finish setup.

err.wordpressDirectories: Restore project_root = {base_dir} and web_root = {base_dir}\public before installing WordPress.
err.wordpressDownload: Unable to download WordPress from the official server. Check your connection, proxy and certificates, then retry.
